typeProperties.script:
parameters{
	Archive_Folder_Path as string (),
	Created_Date as string (),
	Created_Time as string (),
	Email_Recipients as string (),
	Environment as string (),
	File_Type as string (),
	Inremental_File as boolean (),
	Outbound_Folder_Path as string (),
	Record_Count as integer (),
	Report_Date as timestamp (),
	Source_Path as string ()
}

source(output(
		{Control Number} as string,
		{Detail Record Count} as string,
		{Record Type} as string
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false,
	isolationLevel: 'READ_UNCOMMITTED',
	query: 'SELECT  	 \'TLR\' AS [Record Type] 	,CAST(REPLACE(STR(?,10), SPACE(1), \'0\') AS CHAR(10)) AS [Detail Record Count] 	,\'000000\' + CAST(? AS CHAR(8)) + CAST(? AS CHAR(6)) AS [Control Number]',
	format: 'query',
	staged:false) ~> OLESRCTrailerSourceData
OLESRCTrailerSourceData sink(input(
		Control_Number as string,
		Detail_Record_Count as string,
		Record_Type as string
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false,
	saveOrder: 10000,
	mapColumn(
		Control_Number = {Control Number},
		Detail_Record_Count = {Detail Record Count},
		Record_Type = {Record Type})) ~> FFDSTTrailerDataDestination
